You grow a 10-foot radius sphere of roots in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can roll the ball up to 30 feet along the ground. When the ball enters a Large or smaller creatures space, they must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d10 bludgeoning damage and are drawn into the ball, becoming restrained by it. On a success, the creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space. When the ball moves, any creatures restrained by it move along with it.

When a creature starts their turn inside the ball, they take 4d10 bludgeoning damage from crushing roots. A restrained creature or another one that can reach them can use their action to make a Strength (Athletics) check with a DC equal to your spell save DC, escaping and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

At higher levels. When you cast this spell using a 9th level spell slot, each section of damage increases by an additional 1d10, and the ball affects creatures of size Huge or smaller.
